title: The Router That Sends Users to the Wrong Service
description: The /api route captures /apiculture, and a generic route steals traffic from a more specific service.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: match_route(path,routes) returns the handler of the longest matching prefix at a path-segment boundary, or None/nullopt. / matches all absolute paths. Strip query strings from the request; ignore trailing slashes on prefixes except root. Require absolute request/prefix paths. C++ routes is map<string,string>. Inputs stay unchanged.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
